name: Reconciling waterfall bridge
reader_question: How did an opening balance become the closing balance, and which movements drove it?
relationship: Additive reconciliation: opening + Σ movements = closing, on one consistent basis.
use_when: Opening and closing balances share a basis and every movement is stated
The size and sign of each driver matters
avoid_when: Movements do not reconcile or are on different bases — use parallel-basis-panels
Movements are scenario sensitivities rather than additive changes — use tornado

data_contract.notes: Closing balance; must equal start + Σ deltas

units: One unit throughout; bars keep true geometry (no inflated small movements).

editable: Stacked bar chart with embedded workbook (Edit Data)
not_data_bound: The unfilled 'helper' series holds each float; editing a movement requires recomputing the helper column
Connector hairlines between bars are native shapes positioned from the fixture

table_alternative: A reconciliation table (line item, movement, running balance) for audit-grade lookup.
limitations: Running balances must stay non-negative for the helper-series geometry
Movements are read in sequence; the order is a presentation choice, not causation

excluded_alternatives.form: Stacked bar of opening and closing only
excluded_alternatives.reason: Hides which movements produced the change
Implies flow between nodes rather than an additive balance
